seoTitle: Free Reorder PDF Pages - Rearrange Online
metaDescription: Rearrange PDF pages with an order list like 3,1,2,4-6. Repeat pages, reverse runs and drop the rest. Free, in your browser, nothing uploaded.
intro: Type the new page order, for example 3,1,2,4-6, and download a PDF with the pages arranged that way.
why:
Scans often come out in the wrong order: pages fed upside down, double-sided sheets read front then back, or an appendix that belongs after page two. Fixing that in a heavy editor with drag and drop is slow for long documents, and uploading the file to a website is not an option for private papers.

This tool uses a simple list instead. Write the page numbers in the order you want them. Ranges are allowed, so 4-6 means four, five, six, and a reversed range like 6-4 gives six, five, four. A page may be repeated, and any page you leave out is dropped, so the output can also be a subset. For a plain reversal of the whole file use the Reverse tool. Pages are not re-rendered, encrypted files are refused, and bookmarks and form fields are not kept.
howTo: Type the new order, for example 2,1,3- to swap the first two pages and keep the rest.
Check the page count and download the new PDF.

faq.q: What happens to pages I do not list?
faq.a: They are left out of the new file. Make sure the list includes every page you want to keep. For example 2,1,3- keeps page 3 onwards, but 2,1 would drop the rest.
Yes. Listing a page twice, such as 1,1,2, puts it in the output twice. That is handy for duplicated cover sheets or forms.

faq.q: How do I reverse a block of pages?
faq.a: Write the range backwards: 6-4 outputs 6, 5, 4. You can combine this with other items, for instance 1-3,6-4,7-.

faq.q: Is there a faster way to reverse everything?
faq.a: Yes, the Reverse PDF Page Order tool flips the whole document in one step, without needing to type any page numbers.
